summary: Attendance Justification Feature - Complete testing of justification modal and API endpoints. Fixed a bug where justify endpoint wasn't setting grade_id/section_id, causing justified records to not appear in attendance list. All 9 backend tests pass. Frontend verified: JustificationModal opens on 'Justificado' click, has reason select, note textarea, save button. After save, info icon appears and JustificationInfoPopover shows details.
seed_data_creation: None - used existing students in database
context_for_next_testing_agent: Attendance Justification feature complete. POST /api/attendance/justify now correctly sets grade_id and section_id from student data. GET /api/attendance/students returns justification fields (justification_reason, justification_note, justified_by, justified_by_name, justified_at). Frontend JustificationModal (data-testid='justification-modal') opens when clicking 'Justificado' status button. Modal has reason select (data-testid='justification-reason-select'), note textarea (data-testid='justification-note-input'), save button (data-testid='justification-save-btn'). After save, info icon (data-testid='justification-info-{studentId}') appears. JustificationInfoPopover (data-testid='justification-info-popover') shows motivo, descripcion, registrado por, fecha.

GET /api/attendance/justification-reason.returns_6_reasons: PASS - salud, permiso_familiar, tramite, duelo, viaje, otro

POST /api/attendance/justify.valid_data_returns_200: PASS - Creates/updates attendance with justified status
POST /api/attendance/justify.persists_justification_fields: PASS - justification_reason, justification_note, justified_by, justified_by_name, justified_at
POST /api/attendance/justify.sets_grade_section_ids: PASS - Fixed bug: now sets grade_id and section_id from student data
POST /api/attendance/justify.teacher_can_justify: PASS - Teachers with role 'teacher' can justify

GET /api/attendance/students.returns_justification_fields: PASS - Includes justification_reason, justification_note, justified_by, justified_by_name, justified_at for justified records

GET /api/teacher/attendance.returns_justification_fields: PASS - Teacher portal endpoint includes justification fields

AttendancePage (Admin).justificado_button_opens_modal: PASS - Clicking 'Justificado' status button opens JustificationModal
AttendancePage (Admin).save_button_disabled_without_reason: MINOR - Button should be disabled when no reason selected (timing issue in test)
AttendancePage (Admin).save_closes_modal: PASS - Modal closes after successful save
AttendancePage (Admin).info_popover_shows_details: PASS - Shows Motivo, Descripcion, Registrado por, Fecha

TeacherAttendancePage.justificado_button_opens_modal: PASS - Same functionality as admin page

bug_fixed.issue: POST /api/attendance/justify was not setting grade_id and section_id when creating new attendance records
bug_fixed.impact: Justified records were not appearing in GET /api/attendance/students because the query filters by grade_id and section_id
bug_fixed.fix: Modified justify_attendance endpoint to fetch student's grado_id and seccion_id and include them in the attendance record
